summary: idx_invoices_paid_at was built without CONCURRENTLY during business hours; writes queued for 45 minutes and checkout timed out.
A foreign key added without NOT VALID validated 40M rows under a lock; the dunning worker backed up for an hour.
A column removed from customer_billing_summary silently dropped out of the revenue dashboard; three weeks of reporting were wrong before anyone noticed.
A unique index on customers failed halfway through the deploy on pre-existing duplicates; the release was half-applied and had to be unwound by hand.
A column rename shipped ahead of the mobile release; the app crashed on launch for users who had not updated.
